spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker transiently moved the Uniswap spot price (tradePrice) to an attacker-controlled level before the swap

oracle_used_as_slippage_guard.meaning: buybacks and liquidity manager operations rely on UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice as their slippage guard

twap_derived_from_history.meaning: the TWAP slippage guard derives its price from historical cumulative price data rather than the current spot price

immediate_economic_loss_occurred.meaning: protocol funds were swapped or rebalanced at manipulated rates, producing immediate economic loss in Autonolas buyback/liquidity flows

assumptions: The attacker is permissionless; the report asserts no authorized-caller condition.
The manipulation and resulting loss are potential, not stated as observed in a live transaction.
The guarded operations are buybacks and liquidity manager operations as described.

unresolved.description: No concrete amounts, percentages, or numeric bounds for the economic loss are given, so the loss is represented only as a Boolean occurrence.
The report does not give a numeric definition of the historical TWAP versus spot price relation, so the historical-derivation requirement is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: Loss magnitude and rate deviation are not quantified; only occurrence of immediate economic loss is encoded.
The historical TWAP derivation is a qualitative condition without numeric operands.
Code-level binding of validatePrice behavior is deferred.
